Name: Pandaborn - Factions
Description: Adds the Inkpaws, a playable faction of giant pandas with their own buildings, crops and dishes. They lead water down bamboo flumes to rice paddies, grow tea on dry ground, and work a short day: rested pandas work and walk faster. A Moon Loft invites the Ringtails, red pandas who work from the afternoon bell to dawn. With the Lantern Festival and the Great Flowering. Early access. Needs no other mods. Folktails and Iron Teeth are not changed. Removing the mod breaks Inkpaws saves. Art, code, text and sounds are AI-generated.
